title: cornus hongkongensis subsp. ferruginea
intro: Cornus hongkongensis subsp. ferruginea, commonly known as Hong Kong dogwood, is a plant species in the Cornaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Cornus hongkongensis subsp. ferruginea include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, among others, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties.
